headline: Chinese Households Accelerate Move into Offshore Investments, Moody's Finds
summary: Chinese investors are increasingly shifting capital away from domestic real estate and bank savings into alternative and offshore assets, according to a report from Moody's Ratings.
why: Protracted downturns in China's property market and low domestic benchmark interest rates are altering household savings behavior and global capital flows.

impacts.name: Real Estate
impacts.why: Household capital rotation away from property compounds liquidity challenges across China's real estate sector.
